'''Linton Johnson III''' (born June 13, 1980) is an American former professional [[basketball]] player. He is married to a woman from [[Caserta]],<ref>[http://ricerca.gelocal.it/iltirreno/archivio/iltirreno/2014/08/06/LN_36_04.html Linton Johnson, a Pistoia arriva il pivot intellettuale]</ref> and has Italian citizenship.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.juvecaserta.it/tesserato-linton-johnson/ |title=TESSERATO LINTON JOHNSON - JuveCaserta Basket - Official Web Site |accessdate=2016-03-21 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160327091417/http://www.juvecaserta.it/tesserato-linton-johnson/ |archivedate=2016-03-27 }}</ref>

Linton Johnson is the nephew of former NBA player [[Mickey Johnson]].<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20060411113653/http://www.nba.com/hornets/news/behind_the_numbers.html HORNETS: Behind the Numbers: Linton Johnson]</ref>

==Career==
After a four-year college career at [[Tulane University]],<ref name="raptors">[https://web.archive.org/web/20110628214534/http://sportsillustrated.cnn.com/2008/basketball/nba/wires/03/27/2030.ap.bkn.raptors.johnson.0168/ Raptors sign forward Linton Johnson to 10-day contract]</ref> he began his professional career in [[2003–04 NBA season|2003–04]] as an undrafted<ref name="raptors" /> [[free agent]] playing 41 games including 20 starts for the [[Chicago Bulls]]. He also played for the [[Charlotte Bobcats]], [[San Antonio Spurs]], [[New Jersey Nets]], [[New Orleans Hornets]] and the [[Phoenix Suns]], with whom he signed a 10-day contract late in the [[2007–08 NBA season|2007–08 season]].<ref>[http://www.nba.com/suns/news/tribune_notebook_080222 Suns Notebook: Suns Can't Swing Deal at Deadline; Sign Free Agent Johnson] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080225150116/http://www.nba.com/suns/news/tribune_notebook_080222 |date=February 25, 2008 }}</ref> The Suns did not renew his contract, and on March 27, 2008, Johnson signed another 10-day contract with the [[Toronto Raptors]].<ref name="raptors" /> After the contract expired, Johnson re-signed with the Suns on April 16, 2008.

On March 11, 2009, Johnson was signed to the first of two 10-day contracts by the [[Chicago Bulls]]. It was his second stint with the Bulls.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.suntimes.com/sports/basketball/bulls/1471105,bulls-linton-johnson-031109.article |title=Bulls bring back Johnson; forward on 10-day contract |access-date=2009-03-12 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090316052726/http://www.suntimes.com/sports/basketball/bulls/1471105,bulls-linton-johnson-031109.article |archive-date=2009-03-16 |url-status=dead }}</ref> He was signed for the remainder of the season after initially being released when his second 10-day contract expired. He was waived on July 30, 2009.

In September 2009, Johnson signed with the Orlando Magic.<ref>[http://www.nba.com/magic/news/magic_sign_almond_johnson_prepare_camp_091809.html Magic Sign Almond, Johnson; Prepare for Camp]</ref> He was waived on October 28, 2009.<ref name="nba.com">{{Cite web |url=http://www.nba.com/2009/news/10/28/magic.cuts.ap/index.html |title=Magic waive Johnson, have only 11 players for opener |website=[[NBA.com]] |access-date=2009-10-28 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110628192754/http://www.nba.com/2009/news/10/28/magic.cuts.ap/index.html |archive-date=2011-06-28 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>[https://www.usatoday.com/sports/basketball/nba/2009-10-28-3095923306_x.htm Magic waive reserve Johnson, trim roster to 13]". ''USA Today''. October 28, 2009. Retrieved on October 28, 2009.</ref>

In August 2010 he signed with the Italian pro team [[S.S. Felice Scandone|Air Avellino]].<ref>[https://thehoopsmarket.blogspot.com/2010/08/air-avellino-signs-linton-johnson.html Air Avellino signs Linton Johnson]</ref>

On July 9, 2013, he signed with [[Dinamo Sassari]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Dinamo Sassari announced Linton Johnson|url=http://www.sportando.net/eng/italy/serie-a/59020/dinamo-sassari-announced-linton-johnson.html|accessdate=9 July 2013|newspaper=Sportando.net}}</ref> He parted ways with them on January 22, 2014.<ref>{{cite news|title=Dinamo Sassari, Linton Johnson officially part ways|url=http://www.sportando.net/eng/italy/serie-a/72292/dinamo-sassari-linton-johnson-officially-part-ways.html|accessdate=23 January 2014|newspaper=Sportando.net|date=22 January 2014}}</ref> Next day he signed with [[Pallacanestro Varese]].<ref>{{cite news|title=Cimberio Varese announced Linton Johnson|url=http://www.sportando.net/eng/italy/serie-a/72322/cimberio-varese-announced-linton-johnson.html|accessdate=23 January 2014|newspaper=Sportando.net}}</ref>

In August 2014 he signed a one-year deal with the Italian team [[Pistoia Basket|Giorgio Tesi Group Pistoia]]. On January 22, 2015, he was released by Pistoia Basket.<ref>[http://www.sportando.com/en/italy/serie-a/149542/pistoia-parts-ways-with-linton-johnson.html Pistoia parts ways with Linton Johnson]</ref>

On March 18, 2016, he signed with [[Juvecaserta Basket]] for the rest of the [[2015–16 Lega Basket Serie A|2015–16 Serie A season]].<ref>[http://www.sportando.com/en/italy/serie-a/194437/juvecaserta-sign-linton-johnson.html Juvecaserta sign Linton Johnson]</ref>

On October 19, 2016, he signed with [[Scafati Basket]] for the rest of the [[2016–17 Serie A2 Basket|2016–17 Serie A2 season]].<ref>[http://www.scafatibasket.com/la-givova-scafati-firma-il-centro-linton-johnson/ LA GIVOVA SCAFATI FIRMA IL CENTRO LINTON JOHNSON] {{in lang|it}}</ref><ref>[http://www.sportando.com/en/italy/serie-a2-ovest/214781/givova-scafati-adds-size-with-linton-johnson.html Givova Scafati adds size with Linton Johnson]</ref> On January 24, 2017, he left Scafati and returned to Juvecaserta Basket.<ref>[http://www.sportando.com/en/italy/serie-a/224084/pasta-reggia-caserta-sign-linton-johnson.html Pasta Reggia Caserta sign Linton Johnson]</ref>
